fusions.name: Nettle Flick
fusions.desc: Flicks a stinging cell up to 5 tiles that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at full reach, and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Out of the Crevice
fusions.desc: You dart up to 6 tiles to the target and strike for 14 damage, leaving it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Behind the Frondwork
fusions.desc: Shelters you and your allies for 5 seconds: enemies notice you 60% later and you move 20% faster. The veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Last Hole Left
fusions.desc: Once your health falls below 30%, a shield worth 30% of your maximum health closes over you for 8 seconds. Once every 60 seconds.
